source: &108 What are we going to do?
target: &108 我们该怎么办？

source: &52 Well, what are we going to do?
target: &52 那现在怎么办？

source: &143 Gentlemen, please, there's no cause for concern.
target: &143 各位先生，请冷静，没什么好担心的。

source: &135 My dear, we have all sunk quite a considerable investment into this project, oh my yes.
target: &135 亲爱的，我们在这个项目里可投入了不少资金。是啊，可不少。

source: &109 Dr Regis KNOWS about us. That means Central knows.
target: &109 里吉斯博士知道了我们的事。也就是说，中枢也知道了。

source: &53 Dr Regis going to tell Central everything that happen.
target: &53 里吉斯博士会把发生的事全告诉中枢。

source: &136 Indeed, we must find some way to avoid implication.
target: &136 的确，我们必须想办法脱身。

source: &137 Drs Regis and Lao are only two people, and we have powerful legal connections, oh my yes.
target: &137 里吉斯和劳博士只有两个人，而我们在司法界人脉深厚。是啊，相当深厚。

source: &144 I believe that, though the project cannot succeed, we must salvage what we can.
target: &144 我认为，项目虽然已经失败，我们仍该尽量挽回损失。

source: &110 Most sensible.
&54 Good thinking.
target: &54 好主意。

source: &145 That is why I've decided to turn state's witness, and aid in your prosecution.
target: &145 所以，我决定转为控方证人，协助检方起诉你们。

source: &111 I beg your pardon?
target: &111 你说什么？

source: &55 What?!
&146 Is that enough for you, Charlie?
target: &146 查理，这些够了吗？

source: &1807 Central's heard plenty.
target: &1807 中枢已经听得够多了。

source: &1808 Councillor Deane, I am arresting you for abuses of the democratic process.
target: &1808 迪恩议员，你涉嫌破坏民主程序，我现在依法逮捕你。

source: &1809 Due to the political and high-profile nature of your crimes,
target: &1809 鉴于你的罪行涉及政治，且备受公众关注，

source: &1810 ...sentencing will be carried out by secret tribunal.
target: &1810 ……将由秘密法庭对你判刑。

source: &112 Nina! You can't!
target: &112 妮娜！你不能这样！

source: &1811 Chairman Ran, I am arresting you for attempted disruption of city's infrastructure.
target: &1811 冉主席，你涉嫌企图破坏本市基础设施，我现在依法逮捕你。

source: &56 Okay, I get it, how much you want?
target: &56 好，我懂了。你要多少钱？

source: &147 That means 'no lawyers'.
target: &147 意思就是：没有律师。

source: &138 You would have a hard time prosecuting me for any such thing, Dr Regis.
target: &138 里吉斯博士，你恐怕很难以任何这类罪名起诉我。

source: &1319 He's right, we can't arrest him - despite how he looks, he's not people.
target: &1319 他说得对，我们不能逮捕他。别看他长得像人，他在法律上可不算人。

source: &1812 No, but we can confiscate you as evidence.
target: &1812 不能逮捕，但可以把你作为证物扣押。

source: &1813 I imagine nobody will want to take responsibility for your actions, though.
target: &1813 不过，我想没人愿意为你的行为承担责任。

source: &1320 You're going to be in the lock-up for a long time, anyway.
target: &1320 总之，你要在证物室里待很久了。

source: &1321 Come on.
&148 A job well done! Another triumph for justice.
target: &148 干得漂亮！正义又一次获胜。

source: &1814 I'm amazed...no, disgusted that Central agreed to your plea bargain.
target: &1814 中枢竟然同意跟你做认罪交易，我真是惊讶……不，是恶心。

source: &149 What can I say? Networking is my thing.
target: &149 怎么说呢？我最擅长的就是经营人脉。
